description: MCP proxy: holds risky tool calls for passkey approval; signed receipts you can check offline.

tool_signatures.name: get_api_approvals_rid
tool_signatures.description: Approval details; the browser builds the -04 6.6 payload from mandate+action

tool_signatures.name: get_api_auth_keys
tool_signatures.description: The person's passkeys (active and removed) and the recovery-code count (never the codes)

tool_signatures.name: get_api_auth_recovery-codes
tool_signatures.description: How many codes are left (never the codes)

tool_signatures.name: get_api_mandates_by-key_kid
tool_signatures.description: Active mandates of the current account that a key signed (they stay valid until revoked)

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_keys_add_begin
tool_signatures.description: Registration options for a NEW passkey (excludeCredentials = every passkey of the person)

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_keys_add_confirm
tool_signatures.description: wa-sig (typ dw-key-event) by an ACTIVE passkey of the person, not the new one. 409: KEY_SELF, KEY_NOT_ACTIVE, KEY_EVENT_SIG, WA_*

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_keys_add_finish
tool_signatures.description: The new passkey is created but NOT active: returns the key-event payload a CURRENT passkey must sign

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_keys_kid_remove
tool_signatures.description: wa-sig by an active passkey of the person; the key stops at once, sessions it opened end; what it signed stays valid

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_keys_kid_remove_begin
tool_signatures.description: The key-event payload of a removal. 409 LAST_KEY: the last active passkey is never removed

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_logout-all
tool_signatures.description: Sign out everywhere: ends every session of the account (0.1.1, R-17)

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_recovery-codes
tool_signatures.description: Step-up. 10 new one-time codes, shown ONCE (only scrypt hashes are kept); earlier codes stop working

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_recovery_login
tool_signatures.description: A recovery code: every session of the person ends, a 15-min session that may ONLY add a passkey starts, the person's devices get a push. 401 RECOVERY_INVALID (unknown, used or wrong: one answer)

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_recovery_passkey_begin
tool_signatures.description: Recovery session only: registration options for the new passkey

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_recovery_passkey_finish
tool_signatures.description: Recovery session only: the new passkey is active at once (by recovery-code, recorded in the registry log); the recovery session ends

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_register_finish
tool_signatures.description: Finish registration (attestation none, ES256 only); sets dw_session

tool_signatures.name: post_api_auth_stepup_finish
tool_signatures.description: Finish step-up; later PUT data-patterns / PUT toolmap / POST agents (0.1.2, N-12) / DELETE agent need it within 5 minutes, else 403 STEPUP_REQUIRED

tool_signatures.name: post_api_mandates
tool_signatures.description: Submit mandate + wa-sig envelope; 409 code = -04 code or WA_*

tool_signatures.name: post_api_mandates_draft
tool_signatures.description: Build the -04 mandate map from the form (section 5.3)

tool_signatures.name: post_api_mandates_revoke-batch
tool_signatures.description: One wb envelope of typ revocation (challenge over the items AND the typ) revokes up to 20 mandates. 409: WB_*, KEY_REVOKED, KEY_NOT_ACTIVE, WQ_NOT_MEMBER, MANDATE_NOT_ACTIVE

tool_signatures.name: post_api_org_key-replace
tool_signatures.description: Open the policy request that replaces ONE member's lost key by their newest active passkey; needs = rule recovery (k >= 2 others) or rule policy. 409 NO_NEW_KEY, WQ_POLICY_UNKNOWN

tool_signatures.name: post_v1_actions
tool_signatures.description: Submit a tool call for a decision; repeat of a pending/approved identical call returns the same action

tool_signatures.name: post_v1_actions_rid_present
tool_signatures.description: CONSUME the receipt (before executing the tool)
